create_locallylinearembedding: create LocallyLinearEmbedding to reduce 3D sphere data to 2D with standard, ltsa, hessian, or modified method
create_isomap: create Isomap to embed high-dimensional spherical data into 2D preserving geodesic distances
create_mds: create MDS to find a low-dimensional representation of 3D sphere data respecting original pairwise distances
create_spectral_embedding: create SpectralEmbedding to reduce 3D manifold data to 2D using spectral decomposition
create_tsne: create TSNE to embed 3D spherical manifold data into 2D using t-distributed stochastic neighbor embedding
